elements.text: Lack of parking brake indication on Cessna 560XL
Pilots failing to recognize parking brake was not fully released
Attempt to take off with parking brake engaged
Absence of a pre-takeoff checklist item to verify parking brake release
Conclusion that a checklist item would aid pilots
Recommendation to issue an airworthiness directive
Recommendation to revise type certification basis
Recommendation to include checklist item on pretakeoff checklist
Citation of academic literature on cockpit checklists
